title: loop-admin execution-profile/v1 extension
description: Machine-readable contract for the execution-profile/v1 extension of the shared runner protocol (spec/loop-admin-execution-profile-v1.md). The root is the REQUEST value a launch request carries under ext["execution-profile/v1"], made mandatory by listing ext:execution-profile/v1 in require. $defs carries the adapter-side shapes: the qualifiedProfile an adapter declares and the report it puts under a receipt's or observation's ext. The contract is DESCRIPTIVE of shape: required fields, field types and closed value sets. It deliberately does NOT encode the rules the runner module enforces before Start (the pinned digest names a declared profile; a declared digest is the sha256 of the declared profile's canonical content; the pinned harness, model binding and backend are the declared ones; the request's runner profile id, pinned model, role and budget scope are qualified; every need is declared supported) or at acceptance (the report names the pinned digest, harness and backend; a resumed launch reports each needed dimension restored). Decoding is strict as for the request: exact keys, no repeated key, no null for a defined field. Unknown and unsupported are distinct values; a need refused for either is refused with a different reason, and neither is read as the other.

support.description: supported, unsupported (checked: it does not) or unknown (could not check).

harness.description: The harness implementation and version, bound to the immutable digest and provenance reference of the harness-component bundle.

modelBinding.description: The model profile and the model it pins: a REQUESTED identity, never an observation. The model a run actually used is the observation's actual_model.

backend.description: The qualified execution backend and platform profile.

preservation.description: Per dimension, whether that part of a session survives an operation. Each dimension is declared on its own; none implies another.

operations.description: Preservation by lifecycle operation, in the cell operator vocabulary: resume (paused to running, and v1's continuation of a pinned session) and restart (drain, stop, start).

preservationNeed.description: The dimensions a launch cannot do without for one operation. An absent or false dimension is not needed.

needs.description: What the launch requires of the qualified profile. The budget scope needed is the request's own budget.scope.

qualification.description: Opaque references to the qualification evidence and the limits it holds within. The caller validates them.

qualifiedProfile.description: What an adapter declares it is qualified to run. digest is the sha256 of the profile's compact JSON encoding (members in listed order, strings without HTML escaping, empty lists as []) with digest empty, so content that drifted under an old digest is refused.

runner_profile.description: The runner v1 profile.id this tuple serves.

cancellation.description: Whether a cancel is confirmed by an observed stop.

report.description: The adapter's execution report under a receipt's or observation's ext: the identities it observed running and, for a resumed launch, what it observed restored. Untrusted; it grants no scheduling, provider-write or acceptance authority.
